_comment: Charts whose values were derived independently of engine/bazi.py and
then checked against it -- not captured from its output. Day pillars
were verified by counting days from the 2000-01-01 = 戊午 anchor; month
stems by applying the 五虎遁 rule by hand.
BEFORE PHASE 0 GOES LIVE: the retained practitioner should add 20-30
charts of their own, ideally including people they have read for, and
confirm every pillar. That review is the real acceptance test for this
engine; what is here is only enough to catch regressions.
